sources.snippet: Import from anywhere. Start from a text prompt, upload images and documents, or point Claude at your codebase. Refine with fine-grained controls, then export to Canva, PDF, PPTX, or hand off to Claude Code.

sources.title: Anthropic launches Claude Design, a new product for creating quick visuals
sources.snippet: Anthropic announced on Friday that it’s launching Claude Design, a new experimental product that lets users create visuals like prototypes, slides, one-pagers, and more using Claude.

sources.title: Anthropic just launched Claude Design, an AI tool that turns prompts into prototypes and challenges Figma
sources.snippet: Anthropic today launched Claude Design, a new product from its Anthropic Labs division that allows users to create polished visual work — designs, interactive prototypes, slide decks, one-pagers, and marketing collateral — through conversational prompts and fine-grained editing controls.

sources.title: Claude (AI) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Claude Design is a collaborative visual creation tool released by Anthropic Labs on April 17, 2026, that lets users generate designs, prototypes, slides, and marketing materials through natural-language prompts.

sources.title: How Good is Anthropic's Claude Design? - Designing with AI
sources.snippet: Claude Design is a prompt-driven design tool. You hand it descriptions, screenshots, or a codebase; it produces working prototypes, slides, or one-pagers; you iterate visually through conversation, inline comments, and direct edits.

sources.title: Claude Design: What It Is & Why It Matters (2026)
sources.snippet: Claude Design is an Anthropic Labs product that lets teams collaborate with Claude on visual work. Rather than answering in a chat box, Claude generates branded outputs — prototypes, presentations, one-pagers, and other design artifacts — inside a dedicated workspace.

sources.title: Claude Design: Anthropic's new canvas for designers, PMs, and developers
sources.snippet: Claude Design is a new Anthropic Labs product that turns Claude into a visual collaborator. You describe what you want in plain English, Claude builds a first pass on a canvas, and you refine through chat, inline comments, or sliders.
